name: Michael Reynolds
headline: Senior Business Development Manager | B2B SaaS Sales Leader
summary: Results-driven Senior Business Development professional with 9 years of experience driving revenue growth in B2B SaaS environments. Proven track record of building strategic client relationships, leading complex negotiations, and exceeding sales quotas within competitive enterprise markets. Skilled at leveraging CRM data to optimize pipeline management and close high-value deals.

responsibilities: Lead enterprise sales strategy for SaaS platform targeting mid-to-large B2B clients
Negotiate multi-year contracts with annual values exceeding $500K
Manage and mentor a team of 4 business development representatives
Utilize Salesforce to track pipeline health and forecast quarterly revenue
Collaborate with product and marketing teams to align go-to-market strategies
Managed full sales cycle for SaaS solutions across finance and healthcare verticals
Built and maintained relationships with C-level stakeholders at target accounts
Achieved consistent quota attainment through structured outbound prospecting
Conducted contract negotiations and pricing discussions with enterprise clients
Trained junior sales staff on CRM best practices
Prospected and qualified new business opportunities within SMB and mid-market segments
Delivered product demonstrations and proposals to prospective clients
Maintained accurate records of sales activity in CRM system
Collaborated with customer success team to ensure smooth onboarding
